summary: First draft of ADR-003: the architect process writes a review record, the board face watch fires and re-stamps, a review event reaches the editor, which re-reads proposals; plus a fallback lane where the face ticks every 2 s when the watch cannot start.
rationale: Follows the ADR-003 brief: the four components it names (architect session, review store, the face events route with its watch, the editor) in their two processes, with the flows numbered in the order the brief says matters (stamp, watch, re-stamp, event, re-read). The stamp action is drawn as its own node because ADR-003 decision 2 makes it the only way the face learns what changed. The fallback is a separate lane, dotted, as the brief asks. The events route is accented as the new surface this ADR introduces. The editor re-read is drawn to the store; in the code it goes through the face proposals action, so the records keep one reader. No ADR amendment is implied.
